history.content: My phone is still much slower than my husband's, and it never seems to get on the faster network. Pages take forever to load no matter where I am.

I can help you troubleshoot your phone’s slow data speeds and network issues. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide either your phone number, customer ID, or your full name and date of birth? This will help me check your line and plan details.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you, Sofia. I see your line is active and you have a current data plan. To help resolve your slow data speeds and network issues, I’ll need to check your phone’s current network settings and status.

Could you please let me know if you’re able to run some quick checks on your phone? If so, I’ll guide you through a few steps to diagnose the issue.
Yes, I can run checks on my phone. Please let me know what you need me to do.

Great! Let’s start by checking your phone’s current network status and preferences. Please follow these steps:

1. Check your phone’s status bar for network information:
 • Run the check_status_bar action on your phone and let me know what it shows (especially the signal strength, network type like 4G/5G, and if Airplane Mode or Data Saver is on).

2. Check your network mode preference:
 • Run the check_network_mode_preference action and tell me what network mode your phone is set to (for example, 5G, 4G, 3G, or 2G).

Once you provide these details, I’ll guide you through the next steps to improve your data speed.
My phone's network mode is set to 4G only, not 5G. The status bar shows a weak signal and 4G, with no Airplane Mode or Data Saver enabled.

Thank you for the details. Since your phone is set to “4G only” and you’re seeing a weak signal, this could be limiting your access to faster networks like 5G, especially if 5G is available in your area.

Let’s try switching your network mode to allow both 4G and 5G connections. This may help your phone connect to a faster network when available.

Please change your network mode preference to “4G/5G preferred.” After making this change, check if your signal strength or network type improves. Let me know what you see after updating the setting.
When I tried to change the network mode, I got an error message saying a required argument 'mode' was missing. The setting didn't change.

Thank you for letting me know. It looks like the network mode change requires you to specify the mode exactly. Please try setting your network mode preference to "4g_5g_preferred" (that is, select the option that allows both 4G and 5G networks).

If you have a menu or input field, enter or select “4g_5g_preferred” as the mode. After you do this, check your status bar again to see if your phone connects to 5G or if the signal strength improves. Let me know the result.
My status bar now shows an excellent signal and 5G, with data enabled, Data Saver on, connected to Chestnut-5G, and VPN connected. What should I do next?

Your phone is now connected to 5G with an excellent signal, which is great! However, you mentioned that Data Saver is ON and a VPN is connected. Both of these can slow down your data speeds, even on a fast network.

Let’s do the following:

1. Turn OFF Data Saver mode.
2. Disconnect from the VPN.

After you do both, try loading a web page or app and let me know if your data speed improves. If you need instructions on how to turn off Data Saver or disconnect the VPN, let me know!
Data Saver mode is now OFF. Should I disconnect the VPN next?

Yes, please disconnect the VPN next. VPNs can sometimes slow down your connection, even on a fast 5G network.

After disconnecting the VPN, try browsing the web or using your apps again. Let me know if you notice an improvement in your data speed.
VPN is now disconnected. I noticed the VPN icon disappeared from the status bar. Should I run a speed test to check if my connection has improved?

Yes, please run a speed test on your phone now. This will help us confirm if your connection speed has improved after turning off Data Saver and disconnecting the VPN.

Once you have the speed test results, let me know the download speed and how the connection feels when browsing or using apps.
The speed test shows 5G, excellent signal, and excellent connection quality. My apps and web pages are loading much faster now.

That’s excellent news! Your phone is now connected to 5G with an excellent signal and connection quality, and your apps and web pages are loading much faster. 

To summarize, the main improvements came from:
- Changing your network mode to allow 5G connections.
- Turning off Data Saver mode.
- Disconnecting the VPN.

If you ever notice slow speeds again, you can check these settings as a first step. If you need further assistance or have any other questions, feel free to ask!
Thank you! Everything is working perfectly now with fast speeds on 5G. I appreciate your help.
You’re very welcome, Sofia! I’m glad your connection is now fast and everything is working perfectly on 5G. If you ever need help in the future, just reach out. Have a great day!
